description: S56, recorded again in S68: games from the start of each 3-player preset that reach every end in its table (decision 0016), under the current versions (draft-3p 0.4.0, standard-3p 0.2.0, easy-3p 0.2.0), where each Coast piece first leaves the Coast through A5 (decision 0019). Found by seeded self-play with a policy that takes the wanted win or event and avoids the others (the Good Practice checkmate between Kings: Dark searching at depth 2 against random play); the moves are what the test replays, so the seed is only for reference. The games recorded before S68 are in three-player-ends-before-s68.json. Rows: kinged-checkmates-king, dragon-captures-king, duel-dragon-wins, duel-kinged-wins, tail-stone, dragon-out, draw-both-kings, draw-duel; Easy Start: kinged-checkmates-king, kinged-checkmates-tail, dragon-checkmates-king, draw.
